title: Minigun and mine retest after lifter patch 38
summary: A retest of the minigun and the mine in ONE Map Maker preview after lifter patch 38 fixed the minigun pickup crash (T1516). Idle control, minigun fire, a minigun reload check (the minigun has none), a mine and the pause menu, all in the SAME Map Maker level. Session folder tmp/owner-profiles/mm-weapons3. An earlier run of this script is analysed in docs/t1527-minigun-census-and-callback.md (pickup and fire ran). The fuller weapon plan is tmp/run_weapon_variants.fish.
duration: about 8 minutes after the game is up
prerequisites: Game HDD tmp/hdds/editor-hdd (it holds your Map Maker level). The script builds the private host first, which takes a few minutes.
ONE Map Maker map whose weapon set holds the Minigun and a Mine. The SAME map stays loaded for every phase.

steps.text: Press Enter in this terminal at 'Enter = start the game'. When the window opens drive to the Map Maker yourself: start, players, profile, Map Maker, load your map, open the editor, check the weapon set (Minigun and a Mine), enter the PREVIEW and wait until you can move. Nothing is measured until you continue at a phase prompt.

note_at_end: Whether the minigun pickup and fire worked, whether it overheated, and which mine type it was.
If the game stops: copy the 'unimplemented instruction at ...' line it prints.
stop: At every phase prompt: continue with Enter in this terminal, which starts and again ends a phase. s skips it, q finishes the session. The idle phase stops by itself.
Close the game window only after the last phase (or q): a phase in progress is lost.
send_back: Tell Claude the session finished: folder tmp/owner-profiles/mm-weapons3 (the analysis tables are printed at the end).
Whether the game stopped (and the 'unimplemented instruction' line), and which phases you skipped.

ingame-idle.title: Idle control, minigun and mine map
ingame-idle.go_to: The Map Maker PREVIEW of your map (the same map for every phase), you can move, nothing picked up yet
ingame-idle.do: Stand still. Press no button, do not move the stick, do not pick up or switch to anything. The session stops this phase by itself after 20 s.

ingame-fire:minigun.title: Fire the minigun (retest after patch 38)
ingame-fire:minigun.go_to: The Map Maker PREVIEW of your map (the same map for every phase), you can move, the minigun available to pick up
ingame-fire:minigun.switch: the Minigun (pick it up from its spawner, then D-pad right/left until it is in your hands)
ingame-fire:minigun.do: From rest (barrel not spinning) HOLD fire (RT) for about 5 s so the spin-up delay before the first shot is included, release, wait 3 s, repeat. Do not move or switch weapon.
ingame-fire:minigun.note: any overheating, and how long the barrel took to spin up. If the game stops, copy the 'unimplemented instruction at ...' line

ingame-reload:minigun.title: Minigun reload (expected: none)
ingame-reload:minigun.go_to: The Map Maker PREVIEW of your map (the same map for every phase), you can move, the minigun in your hands
ingame-reload:minigun.do: Press the reload button (X) once and watch. The minigun has no reload code (T1527, INFERRED from the code), so nothing should happen. If nothing reloads, stop the phase after a few seconds (or answer s at the prompt) and say so in your report.

ingame-fire:mine.title: Place mines (retest after patch 38)
ingame-fire:mine.go_to: The Map Maker PREVIEW of your map (the same map for every phase), you can move, a mine weapon available to pick up
ingame-fire:mine.switch: the Mine (pick it up from its spawner, then D-pad right/left until it is in your hands)
ingame-fire:mine.do: Place mines only (tap RT a few times). Do not detonate by hand, do not move far and do not switch weapon.
ingame-fire:mine.note: which mine type it was (remote, proximity or timed). If the game stops, copy the 'unimplemented instruction at ...' line

ingame-pause.title: Open and close the pause menu (retest)
ingame-pause.go_to: The Map Maker PREVIEW of your map (the same map for every phase), you can move, any weapon in your hands
ingame-pause.do: Open the pause menu (Start), wait a moment, close it again, repeat. Change no setting.
